title: Alfred Williams, Eddie Hickman, the Alcorn brothers and Willie Humphrey
summary: He runs through musicians who played with him and others, including bassists, the Alcorns, and Willie Humphrey, whom he says he first brought out in a band.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: He's had a brother, Kenia, that's the one. He was a violin player in the Kish Sonson. He'd tell you to play with him three or four pieces. Like hustling and that, send a job down the district. He'd play like that. He'd look like happy, huh? So, um... Very happy. Very happy. Very happy. He died now. He died up in Chicago. He could play with me when I was playing with John Robeser. He used to play with all these bands down there. They were very happy. Alfred Williams, you know him, right? Alfred Williams used to play with us. He played with us before he went to Texas. Eddie Hickman, he was a bass player too. He used to play with the Alcorn brothers. Which brothers? Which brothers? Well, they said that George McCullum was his brother. After that, they said that they were running kids. But I then was a saxophone player. I was a saxophone player. Oliver? Oliver? Yeah.

Oliver? Oliver? He used to play with them. He used to play with me sometime on the job. but I was a saxophone player. All of them? Yeah. All of them? Yeah, he used to play with, Hickory used to play with him, you see. He used to play with me some time on the job. You know Joe was in there, huh? The drummer, and Henry was in there. Son Johnson, you know that? You know Son Johnson, a saxophone player? Oh, yeah. Where's every artist you know him? He teaches now. He teaches somebody down in the conservatory a long time. I mean, Willie Humpert. You know Willie Humpert over there? They teaches the gather down there, every day. I was the first one, bought him out in a band. I bought him out with Kid High. Then the band from all up the north started sending for him, but he didn't take it. And he got nine. He had about 14 kids. And now, he's a little better fella. He's my darling, man. I don't believe he's very much when he's always. He's young. He's about 41 or 42 years old now. He's a big boy. He can play. He can play. He's finished. He's finished with everything in music. Ask him, did he know Son Fuclos?
